title: TUI-1 canonical state - POINTER
purpose: This file carries NO counts. It exists only to say where counts live, so a reader cannot mistake a dated snapshot for a live figure.

counts.rule: If a number is not in /api/state it is NOT established. Do not carry it forward from an older report, and do not reconcile two stale figures by picking one.

coverage_states.rule: indexed / runnable / measured / signed are four different questions and are never summed.

revenue.rule: External customer revenue only. Internal settlements are never revenue.
